I am planting maize on my almost-one-hectare plot again this season. Since I am in the Guinea Savanna and maize does better with fertilizer, I will buy some NPK and urea from the market to apply. I will use the improved seed I got from the agro-dealer because it gives better yield when combined with fertilizer. My family will do most of the work, but I may hire a few laborers to help with weeding when the rains come.
